title: Improving the 32-Bit AES Super-S-box Affine Approximation
summary: A simplified Greedy-Reduction variant found a size-60 affine approximation for the zero-key 32-bit AES Super-S-box; improving it or finding a stronger result remains open.

formal_statement.body: For the 32-bit AES Super-S-box with the zero key, a simplified variant of the Greedy-Reduction algorithm produced an affine approximation of size 60; the unresolved task is to improve the size of this approximation or otherwise obtain a stronger result for this same instance.

scope.domain: Automated linear cryptanalysis of affine approximations for the 32-bit AES Super-S-box.
parameters: 32-bit width: identifies the target AES Super-S-box
Zero key: fixes the target instance
Affine-approximation size: reported quantity with baseline 60
scope.unresolved_remainder: Improve the size-60 affine approximation, or otherwise obtain a stronger result, for the same zero-key 32-bit AES Super-S-box instance.

citations.label: Algorithmic Toolkit for Linearization of S-boxes

progress.summary: The source reports a size-60 affine approximation obtained by a simplified Greedy-Reduction variant for the zero-key 32-bit AES Super-S-box. It explicitly leaves improving this difficult case as a challenge.
citation_labels: Alex Biryukov et al., Algorithmic Toolkit for Linearization of S-boxes
